incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: PD-INC-4823 — service=inference-queue-eu-west, symptom=queue-depth+latency spike, severity=p2. Auto-routing to current on-call. https://pd.company/PD-INC-4823

pagerbot: Auto-ack by sarah (oncall). Claim recorded: sarah. Responders: sarah, tom. Escalation window: 5m.

sarah: On it. Starting immediate mitigation: scale dedicated pool for eu-west, check autoscaler, examine recent deploys. ETA for first scaling effect ~4m.

tom: @sarah any sign of requests actually failing vs just high latency? customer-impact?

sarah: Partial 503s showing up. Error rate ~2.3% over last 5m, errors concentrated on requests with seq_len>2048. Affected tenants: DRM-prod, billing-service (sampled via trace ids). Mitigations kicking off: 1) scale dedicated-pool-eu-west 8->16gpus 2) enable fallback routing to redwood-compact-v1 for burst traffic 3) force K/V cache sticky mode to persistent to avoid cold KV misses. Logs snippet: ```[2026-03-17T10:01:12Z] inference-queue: enqueue latency=720ms qdepth=3125 errors=1.9% 
[2026-03-17T10:02:05Z] autoscaler: request_scale delta=+8 gpus target=16```

incident-bot: Scaling action: dedicated-pool-eu-west scaling from 8 -> 16 GPUs triggered by autoscaler (rule: queue_depth>1500). Link: https://console.company/scale/4823

sarah: Scaling in progress. Enabling tiered-routing fallback now (`route_override: redwood-compact-v1`), applying sticky-kvcache=true. I'll monitor error-rate and latency and update here every 5-10m. @james please handle customer comms for DRM-prod/billing-service.

james: Got it — drafting initial customer notice: "We've detected elevated error rates affecting inference requests in eu-west; mitigation in progress (scaling + fallback). We'll update in 10 minutes with impact and ETA." Holding until sarah confirms metrics improvement.

sarah: Status +6m: scaling completed ~+3m, dedicated pool at 16 GPUs. Error rate down to 0.7% over last 2m, tail latency for seq_len>2048 improved ~30%. Still seeing occasional spikes (~0.2% 503s). Owning incident until stable for 15m. If errors resurge, will escalate to infra for cross-region failover to us-west.

tom: :thumbsup: good run. If you want me to prepare the failover steps I can pre-warm us-west pool and stage route changes. Keep me posted and hand off if you need me to take ownership.

sarah: Thanks — will keep ownership unless we hit >1% errors again. Next status update +10m or earlier on any regression.

james: Sending customer note now. Tagging incidents for follow-up post-mortem.
